objective: Identify economic regime exhaustion after <= 0.50 ATR giveback from maxMFE
rationale: At a 0.50 ATR pullback depth alone across all pullbacks, only 23.4% exhaust, while 76.6% resume to set a new maxMFE. Declaring exhaustion unconditionally at 0.50 ATR produces a massive false-exhaustion rate (76.6%), abandoning a median of 1.59 ATR in missed continuation.
